adjudication.rationale: The diff adds only unit-style specs with heavy mocking at the seams of the embed flow: `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` stubs `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` and mocks `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve` instead of exercising the job + retriever + import path, and `spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb` mocks `perform_retrieve`/`retrieved_recently?` rather than running the real retrieval/import behavior. While `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` tests `TopicEmbed.import` in isolation, there is no end-to-end test that actually performs `GET /embed/best` with a missing embed, runs `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` / `TopicRetriever` to create the topic via `TopicEmbed.import(_remote)`, and then verifies a subsequent `GET /embed/best` renders posts. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap for newly introduced wiring/round-trip behavior, but not a demonstrated functional defect.
